_about: Example of the study team's --manuscript-params file (JSON or YAML). Copy it outside the repository, fill it in, and pass it to reproduce_study.py --manuscript-params and to python -m omop_etl.manuscript_checks --params. Every value below is a placeholder; the package stores no names. Keys the package reads: title, authors (name, affiliation or affiliations, email, corresponding, role), irb_statement, consortium, consortium_short. ORCIDs, funding and conflicts of interest are not read yet.
title: Multi-Center Benchmark of Traditional Machine Learning Models for 30-Day Hospital Readmission Risk Prediction

authors.name: Second Author, PhD
authors.role: Software, formal analysis, writing (review and editing).
